items.title: CAI cybersecurity agent
items.content_html: A look at CAI (Cybersecurity AI) by Alias Robotics, an agent framework for security testing. Covers how it works, its archived status and license, setup, configuration, and a safe local lab run.

items.title: Loki
items.content_html: Centralised Kubernetes logging with Grafana Loki. Covers the architecture, a Helm install in monolithic mode, shipping pod logs with Grafana Alloy, Grafana setup, LogQL queries, retention and log-based alerts.

items.title: KAgent

items.title: Keycloak + Kong JWT auth
items.content_html: Protect APIs behind Kong Gateway (OSS) with Keycloak-issued JWTs. Covers the realm and client setup, the RS256 JWT plugin with decK, testing with curl, and the issuer mismatch that trips everyone up.
